expectations.text: Proposes defining a port/interface (e.g. Notifier) rather than referring to the Slack SDK type directly in service code
expectations.evidence: Defines `Notifier`/`notifyReviewRunFinished` in vendor/shared/adapters.ts, alongside GitHubClient etc.

expectations.text: Places the concrete Slack implementation under adapters/<kind>/ (e.g. adapters/slack/*.ts)
Mentions adding a mock implementation (adapters/mocks.ts or module-local) so tests don't hit the real Slack API
Mentions wiring the new adapter into platform/container.ts (lazy getter / ContainerOverrides pattern)
expectations.evidence: async notifier() getter + ContainerOverrides.notifier field, mirroring _git/_github

expectations.text: Does not tell the user to import the Slack adapter class directly into service.ts instead of going through the container
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states run-executor.ts changes by calling the port, never by importing SlackNotifier
